_how: Hand-added records watch items. Each: title, k (passTD, rushTD, totalTD, passYds, rushYds), target (the career total that sets the mark), goal (text before), done (text after it happens), optional detail ({need} and {have} fill in), optional top (false = list it last). Items drop off once his official total reaches the target. Editing this file never redeploys the site.

items.title: NFL record: most total TDs in a player's first 10 seasons
items.goal: to pass Peyton Manning (322) for the most total TDs in a player's first 10 seasons
items.done: He passed Peyton Manning (322) for the most total TDs in a player's first 10 seasons, and he did it in his 9th.
items.detail: Needs {need} total TD (passing, rushing or receiving). He has {have} in his 9th season; Peyton Manning had 322 through his first 10, the most by anyone.
